components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-confidence action for recording, setup, and saving.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:36px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-control, 10px); padding:8px 14px; background:var(--palette-accent); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(31 44 34 / 0.22); font:500 13px/1.45 'Mona Sans Variable','Mona Sans','Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition:transform 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--palette-accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--palette-accent); outline-offset:2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition:none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The bordered paper-surface action used for ordinary supporting choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:36px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid var(--palette-line); border-radius:var(--radius-control, 10px); padding:8px 14px; background:var(--palette-surface); color:var(--palette-ink); box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgb(29 31 28 / 0.05); font:500 13px/1.45 'Mona Sans Variable','Mona Sans','Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition:transform 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--palette-surface-subtle); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--palette-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action that gains a subtle surface only on interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; min-height:36px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-control, 10px); padding:8px 14px; background:transparent; color:var(--palette-muted); font:500 13px/1.45 'Mona Sans Variable','Mona Sans','Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition:transform 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--palette-surface-subtle); color:var(--palette-ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--palette-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The compound bordered field used to find saved transcripts.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input placeholder="Search transcripts" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; width:320px; max-width:100%; align-items:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid var(--palette-line-strong); border-radius:var(--radius-control, 10px); padding:0 12px; background:var(--palette-surface); color:var(--palette-muted); } .ds-search svg { width:16px; height:16px; flex:none; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-search input { min-width:0; width:100%; border:0; outline:0; padding:8px 0; background:transparent; color:var(--palette-ink); font:400 13px/1.45 'Mona Sans Variable','Mona Sans','Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--palette-muted); } .ds-search:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--palette-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The selected destination in the deep neutral desktop sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; width:220px; height:40px; align-items:center; gap:12px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-control, 10px); padding:0 12px; background:var(--palette-navigation-raised); color:var(--palette-inverse); font:500 13px/1.45 'Mona Sans Variable','Mona Sans','Segoe UI',sans-serif; text-align:left; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:var(--palette-navigation-hover); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--palette-accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav-item svg { width:17px; height:17px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-nav-item i { width:4px; height:4px; margin-left:auto; border-radius:999px; background:var(--palette-accent); }

components.name: Recording Status Badge
components.description: A compact text-and-dot indicator for live recorder state.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:999px; padding:4px 10px; background:var(--palette-accent-soft); color:var(--palette-accent-ink); font:500 12px/1.4 'Mona Sans Variable','Mona Sans','Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-status i { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--palette-accent); } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--palette-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Workspace Card
components.description: The flat bordered panel used for transcript, recorder, history, and settings groups.
components.css: .ds-card { width:320px; border:1px solid var(--palette-line); border-radius:var(--radius-panel, 14px); padding:20px; background:var(--palette-surface); color:var(--palette-ink); font-family:'Mona Sans Variable','Mona Sans','Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin:0; font-size:17px; line-height:1.35; font-weight:620; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-card p { margin:8px 0 0; color:var(--palette-muted); font-size:15px; line-height:1.6; } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color:var(--palette-line-strong); }

components.name: Preference Switch
components.description: The compact explicit toggle used for recording and local-storage preferences.
components.css: .ds-switch { position:relative; width:40px; height:24px; border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:2px; background:var(--palette-accent); transition:background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-switch span { display:block; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--palette-surface); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(29 31 28 / 0.16); transform:translateX(16px); transition:transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-switch:hover { background:var(--palette-accent-hover); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--palette-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Voice Overlay
components.description: The system-wide compact recorder with cancel, live waveform, and finish controls.
components.css: .ds-overlay { display:grid; width:120px; height:36px; grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr) 24px; align-items:center; gap:6px; border:1px solid var(--palette-overlay-line); border-radius:var(--radius-floating, 16px); padding:5px; background:var(--palette-overlay); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgb(18 20 17 / 0.22); } .ds-overlay button { display:grid; width:24px; height:24px; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:0; background:var(--palette-overlay-raised); color:var(--palette-overlay-text); font:500 16px/1 'Mona Sans Variable','Mona Sans','Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition:transform 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-overlay button:hover { background:var(--palette-navigation-line); } .ds-overlay button:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-overlay button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--palette-accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-overlay .ds-finish { background:#fff; color:var(--palette-navigation); } .ds-wave { display:flex; height:20px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:2px; } .ds-wave i { display:block; width:2px; border-radius:999px; background:currentColor; } .ds-wave i:nth-child(1),.ds-wave i:nth-child(5) { height:5px; } .ds-wave i:nth-child(2),.ds-wave i:nth-child(4) { height:11px; } .ds-wave i:nth-child(3) { height:17px; }

narrative.overview:
Flow is a conventional premium desktop productivity workspace, played straight. Its warm paper canvas and deep graphite navigation frame a focused working area; a low-chroma forest accent identifies interaction and recording state without turning the interface into a brand spectacle. The result should feel calm, capable, and immediately legible during a time-sensitive task.

Hierarchy comes from compact Mona Sans typography, measured spacing, explicit state language, and consistent surface boundaries. Most UI remains visually quiet so the live transcript, waveform, timer, and primary recording action can carry the user's attention. Behavior stays familiar: controls are compact, states are named, and recoverability is always visible.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper application canvas with softly off-white working surfaces.
Deep graphite sidebar that anchors the desktop workspace.
One low-chroma forest interaction color, used sparingly and consistently.
Compact Radix/shadcn-style controls with visible focus and direct state labels.
Restrained borders and elevation; no gradients, glass, or oversized decoration.
Transcript-first working area with a dedicated recorder panel.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Forest green is the only general interaction accent. Semantic success, danger, and warning tones communicate outcomes; they do not compete for ordinary actions.

rules.name: The Quiet Canvas Rule
rules.body: Use the warm canvas behind paper surfaces. Do not add gradients, decorative color fields, or translucent glass.

rules.name: The Working Type Rule
rules.body: Reserve the timer scale for elapsed time and the transcript scale for dictated content. Ordinary interface copy stays compact.

rules.name: The Explicit State Rule
rules.body: Never rely on color or iconography alone; state changes retain a concise text label.

rules.name: The Transcript-First Rule
rules.body: At normal desktop sizes, the transcript owns the flexible column and the recorder remains a stable 304px tool panel.

rules.name: The Compact Stack Rule
rules.body: Below 960px, preserve full function by stacking the same panels; do not introduce a separate mobile navigation model or hide recording state.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and settings sections use a border without a shadow. Apply elevation only when layering, stickiness, or detached placement requires it.

rules.name: The Contained Curve Rule
rules.body: Radius communicates component scale, not decoration: 10px for controls, 14px for panels, 16px for detached floating surfaces.

dos: Do keep the transcript visually dominant and the recorder action unambiguous.
Do reuse the centralized `--palette-*` values exposed through Tailwind theme aliases.
Do use text, iconography, and color together for recording, processing, success, warning, and error states.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, semantic controls, status announcements, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use borders and tonal layering before reaching for elevation.
Do keep controls compact and align them to the 4px spacing foundation.
donts: Don't add gradients, glass effects, oversized decoration, or novelty metaphors.
Don't introduce another general-purpose accent color alongside Forest Signal.
Don't shadow ordinary cards or settings sections.
Don't hide critical recording state behind icon-only communication.
Don't replace the 960px stacked workspace with a diminished mobile-only experience.
Don't turn transcript, history, settings, or overlay behavior into decorative UI at the expense of recovery and control.
